why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose 4.8% and Queries per User rose 2.3%, while success per search slipped 0.72%. Users searched more because first results missed, not because they wanted more.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: The drop held steady from the first days after exposure to the last, so it is not a novelty effect.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Reformulation rose most on tail queries, which points to v7 ranking rare queries worse. No cut has tested this yet.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A per-query success cut showing success per query is flat and the drop comes only from extra low-success queries from a few heavy users.
